description: Implementation of the FileDescriptor class managing file descriptors with duplication, validation, reset, and release functionalities within the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace.

classes.name: FileDescriptor
classes.description: A class encapsulating a file descriptor with safe management, duplication, and validation methods.

methods.name: FileDescriptor()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the file descriptor to an invalid state (-1).

methods.name: FileDescriptor(int fd)
methods.description: Constructor that duplicates an existing file descriptor if valid.

methods.name: FileDescriptor(const FileDescriptor &other)
methods.description: Copy constructor that duplicates the file descriptor from another instance.

methods.name: operator=(FileDescriptor &&other) noexcept
methods.description: Move assignment operator transferring ownership of the file descriptor.

methods.name: operator=(const FileDescriptor &other)
methods.description: Copy assignment operator duplicating the file descriptor from another instance.

methods.name: ~FileDescriptor()
methods.description: Destructor that closes the file descriptor if valid.

methods.name: isValid() const
methods.description: Checks if the file descriptor is valid (non-negative).

methods.name: reset(int fd)
methods.description: Resets the file descriptor to a new value, closing the old one if necessary.

methods.name: clear()
methods.description: Clears the file descriptor, resetting it to an invalid state.

methods.name: release()
methods.description: Releases ownership of the file descriptor and returns it, setting internal descriptor to invalid.
